title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
abstract: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure. The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion. We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In our hypothetical course, Agentic Models and Local Inference, today’s lecture is on Muse Glimmer. Recent work such as Tongyi DeepResearch and GLM-4.5 reflects a field moving toward models that can reason, use tools, and carry out extended tasks. Meta’s contribution takes up a practical tension in that trend: an agent needs to manage several steps, but its model must still fit on consumer hardware. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在我们这门假想的课程“智能体模型与本地推理”中，今天的课讲的是Muse Glimmer。通义DeepResearch和GLM-4.5等近期工作反映出，这个领域正朝着能够推理、使用工具并执行长时任务的模型方向发展。Meta的贡献则回应了这一趋势中的一个现实矛盾：智能体需要管理多个步骤，但它的模型仍然必须能装进消费级硬件。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, why does running the agent locally matter if it still needs tools and context?
segments.zh: 教授，如果智能体仍然需要工具和上下文，为什么在本地运行它仍然重要？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The motivating example is a person asking an agent on their own computer to build a Home Assistant dashboard through OpenCode. That means planning and tool use over multiple steps, not just answering one prompt. Meta describes a video of Muse Glimmer completing this task. It is one author-provided demonstration, not evidence of general reliability. Local inference can keep context from being sent to a cloud model, but it does not prove that the agent or its environment is safe.
segments.zh: 这个例子讲的是，有人在自家电脑上让智能体通过 OpenCode 搭建一个 Home Assistant 仪表盘。这意味着要跨多个步骤进行规划和工具调用，而不只是回答一个提示。Meta 描述了一段 Muse Glimmer 完成这项任务的视频。这只是作者提供的一个演示，并不能证明它普遍可靠。本地推理可以避免把上下文发送给云端模型，但这并不能证明智能体或其运行环境是安全的。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The model is a dense, 30-billion-parameter system that accepts text and images and produces text. The authors distill it from the larger Muse Spark model, using teacher feedback during pretraining, then add domain-specific and agent-focused training. Think of distillation as transferring guidance from a larger model into a smaller one. The goal is not simply to shrink a general assistant; it is to shape a model for sustained agent workflows while keeping deployment on consumer hardware in view.
segments.zh: 这个模型是一个稠密的300亿参数系统，接受文本和图像输入，输出文本。作者从更大的Muse Spark模型中蒸馏出它，在预训练阶段利用教师反馈，然后加入领域特定和面向智能体的训练。可以把蒸馏理解为把更大模型的指导能力迁移到更小的模型里。目标不只是缩小一个通用助手，而是塑造一个能支撑持续智能体工作流的模型，同时兼顾在消费级硬件上部署。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: what does the agent-focused training actually teach the model to do?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：这种以智能体为重点的训练到底教会了模型做什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors train on supervised examples and agent trajectories, then use reinforcement learning. An important step is on-policy distillation: the student model generates its own sequences, and the teacher gives feedback on those particular sequences. That matters because a student may take different paths from its teacher. Training only on the teacher’s paths can leave a mismatch when the student is deployed. The paper says this step improves later reinforcement-learning outcomes, but does not give a numerical ablation isolating that effect.
segments.zh: 作者先用监督样本和智能体轨迹训练，然后再用强化学习。一个关键步骤是同策略蒸馏：学生模型自己生成序列，教师针对这些具体序列给出反馈。这一点很重要，因为学生可能会走和教师不同的路径。只用教师的路径训练，部署学生模型时就可能出现不匹配。论文说这一步改善了后续的强化学习效果，但没有给出单独隔离该效应的数值消融实验。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The deployment constraint is memory. In B-F-16, the model’s weights occupy 55.7 gigabytes. The authors target language-model weights below 20 gigabytes so memory remains for the K-V cache, image encoder, and speculative drafter. Their dense-versus-M-O-E study also favors dense configurations under a 32-gigabyte inference-memory ceiling. They report 2 times to 2.5 times greater compute efficiency for dense configurations in their tested setup, not a general rule that dense models always win.
segments.zh: 部署上的限制在于内存。在B-F-16中，模型权重占用55.7GB。作者的目标是把语言模型权重控制在20GB以下，以便为K-V缓存、图像编码器和投机解码器留出内存。他们在稠密与M-O-E的对比研究中也倾向于在32GB推理内存上限下选择稠密配置。他们报告称，在测试设置中，稠密配置的计算效率高出2到2.5倍，这并不是说稠密模型总是胜出的普遍规律。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify speculative decoding, and does it mean the model uses fewer tokens?
segments.zh: 你能解释一下投机解码吗？这是否意味着模型使用的token更少？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A small drafter proposes a block of tokens, then the larger model checks those proposals and accepts or corrects them. That can make generation practical under a tight memory budget, but it adds computation; it does not establish fewer output tokens or fewer attempts. The paper describes practical speed qualitatively and gives no numerical speedup for Muse Glimmer. Meta’s separate author post reports speed increases for a specific quantized setup, but those figures are not paper benchmark results.
segments.zh: 一个小型起草模型先提出一组token，然后由更大的模型检查这些提议，并接受或修正它们。这能在内存预算紧张的情况下让生成变得可行，但会增加计算量；它并不能证明输出token更少或尝试次数更少。论文只是定性地描述了实际速度，并没有给出Muse Glimmer的数值加速比。Meta另一篇作者文章报告了某个特定量化配置下的速度提升，但这些数字不是论文的基准结果。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The paper also checks what compression does to task quality. Across 15 downstream benchmarks, B-F-16 averages 75.7% accuracy, while the 4-bit Q4KM version averages 74.8%. Those averages suggest a modest difference across the selected tests, not identical performance on every task. The authors also report similar reasoning lengths for their conservative quantization schemes. Response length is not elapsed time, however, and it does not show that quantization makes the model more efficient in every sense.
segments.zh: 论文还考察了压缩对任务质量的影响。在15个下游基准上，B-F-16平均准确率为75.7%，而4位Q4KM版本平均为74.8%。这些平均值说明在所选的测试中差异不大，但并非每个任务上的表现都完全相同。作者还报告称，其保守量化方案的推理长度相近。不过，响应长度并不等于实际耗时，也不能说明量化让模型在各个方面都更高效。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How strong is the evidence that this is better at agent work, rather than just one favorable example?
segments.zh: 有多大把握说它在智能体任务上确实更强，而不只是一个有利的例子？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The clearest comparison is WildClawBench, a set of 60 tasks spanning productivity, coding, social interaction, search, creative synthesis, and safety alignment. Each task gets a grader score from 0 to 1; the reported result is the unweighted mean across tasks, averaged over three runs. Muse Glimmer scores 47.6 on the table’s scale, compared with 37.6 for Gemma 4 31B and 43.2 for Qwen 3.6 27B. That is a meaningful lead on this benchmark, not a guarantee across agent tasks.
segments.zh: 最清晰的对比来自WildClawBench，这是一组涵盖生产力、编程、社交互动、搜索、创意综合和安全对齐的60个任务。每个任务由评分器给出0到1的分数；报告结果是各任务未加权平均分，并在三次运行上取平均。Muse Glimmer在该表尺度上得分为47.6，相比之下Gemma 4 31B为37.6，Qwen 3.6 27B为43.2。这在这个基准上是明显的领先，但并不能保证在所有智能体任务上都占优。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the scorecard is not one shared metric or an overall win rate?
segments.zh: 所以这张评分表并不是一个统一的指标，也不是一个总体的胜率？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The wider scorecard covers areas such as tool use, reasoning, coding, multimodal tasks, memory, and privacy or security, and its rows use different evaluations. Competitors lead on some rows, including GDPval-AA, OSWorld-Verified, SWE-Bench Verified, and TerminalBench 2.1. The paper also notes that some results are internally run while others come from sources or model developers. The authors propose that agent trajectories help with tool choice and recovery, but the comparisons do not isolate which training ingredient caused the results.
segments.zh: 正是如此。更全面的评分表覆盖了工具使用、推理、编程、多模态任务、记忆以及隐私或安全等领域，各行采用不同的评估方式。竞争对手在某些行上领先，包括GDPval-AA、OSWorld-Verified、SWE-Bench Verified和TerminalBench 2.1。论文还指出，部分结果是内部运行的，而另一些则来自外部来源或模型开发者。作者提出智能体轨迹有助于工具选择和恢复，但这些比较并未分离出究竟是哪个训练成分导致了这些结果。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: This work fits into a broader movement toward tool-using models, seen in systems such as Tongyi DeepResearch and GLM-4.5. Its emphasis is the integration of agent-focused training with a local deployment target, rather than establishing a wholly new distillation principle. The authors’ dense-model choice is similarly bounded: their scaling comparison uses internal text and code data, estimated compute utilization, and different training allocations. It helps explain their design choice under a memory limit, but does not settle dense-versus-M-O-E debates in general.
segments.zh: 这项工作属于更广泛的工具使用模型潮流，通义DeepResearch和GLM-4.5等系统就是这一趋势的体现。它的重点是把面向智能体的训练与本地部署目标结合起来，而不是确立一套全新的蒸馏原理。作者选择稠密模型同样有其边界：他们的扩展性比较使用的是内部文本和代码数据、估算的计算利用率以及不同的训练分配。这有助于解释他们在内存限制下的设计选择，但并不能从总体上解决稠密模型与M-O-E之争。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The main implication is that model quality and deployment constraints have to be designed together. A local agent may suit workflows involving private context, but local execution alone does not guarantee privacy, security, or dependable behavior. The benchmark lead offers evidence that Muse Glimmer can handle a broad set of longer-horizon tasks, while its mixed scorecard and the limits of the study caution against treating that result as universal. The useful research question is how to evaluate agent capability under realistic memory and tool constraints.
segments.zh: 主要含义是，模型质量和部署约束必须一起设计。本地智能体可能适合涉及私有上下文的工作流，但仅靠本地执行并不能保证隐私、安全或可靠行为。基准上的领先提供了证据，说明Muse Glimmer能处理大量更长周期的任务，而其喜忧参半的评分卡以及研究的局限性提醒人们，不要把这个结果当作普遍适用。有用的研究问题是，如何在现实的内存和工具约束下评估智能体能力。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: To return to the Home Assistant example, the paper makes a credible case for building an agent-oriented model that can fit within a consumer-memory budget and performs well on one broad agent benchmark. It does not show that every household workflow will succeed, or that one training component explains the measured performance. The takeaway is specific: fitting an agent-oriented model locally is the design target, not a claim that every agent workload is solved. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 回到Home Assistant这个例子，这篇论文令人信服地论证了：可以构建一个面向智能体的模型，既能装进消费级内存预算，又能在某个覆盖面较广的智能体基准上表现良好。但它并没有证明每一种家庭工作流都能成功，也没有证明某一个训练组件就能解释测得的性能。结论很具体：在本地装下一个面向智能体的模型才是设计目标，而不是宣称所有智能体工作负载都已解决。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
